inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Step id of the translate step.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Display name of the translate step.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Runtime expression resolving to the array of items to translate, one process each.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Arguments passed to the translate entry for each item.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used by the translation skill.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Time limit in minutes for each document's translation, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum Claude turns for each document's translation, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxBudgetUsd
inputs.description: Runaway guard in USD (API list price) for each document's translation, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxRepairs
inputs.description: Same-session model repair attempts after the output check fails; zero keeps the verify-only gate.

inputs.name: verify
inputs.description: Per-item deterministic output check command; the no-op default keeps verification optional for direct callers.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.description: Claude tools of the translate step; replaces the whole default list. Keep Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, and Bash(jq empty:*); add only narrow Bash(<command>:*) rules.

inputs.name: continueOnError
inputs.description: Let the run go on when a document fails, for a caller that drops incomplete outputs itself.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: The translate command or skill invoked once per item.
